title: MZ Please recommend different turn based system plugin s for MZ.

posts.author: noobmegarevenge
posts.body:
Hello! i'm currently at the "pre-alpha" state of my game and i am trying to decide the battle system for it.
earlier i wanted to attempt a chrono trigger style battle system.
but i have not succeeded with that idea.
i had Mog hunter's chrono engine in my game but since i'm using rpg maker mz it became complicated to use it since i am still learning how to use rpg maker mz.
i have FOSSIL but i only use it with simpler MV plugins like that rolling credits one by MOG (thank you MOG).
my skills are a tad bit limited when it comes to my programming and that has led me to get stuck deciding the battle system.
ANY RECOMMENDATIONS ARE GOOD doesnt matter what plugin it is.
if there are any plugins similar to chrono engine but made for rpg maker mz i would love to check them out.
but really if you all want to recommend me any MZ battle plugins feel free to say it.
-----2026 noobmegarevenge

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I did play Chrono Trigger (if only a little), so I'm fairly confident in saying it's similar to an ATB system. That's why I suggested specifically Time Progress Battle (Active). You might still need plugins to get certain kinds of effects, though.
For making the battle play out on the map instead of with a battleback, the simplest thing you can do is just not set a battleback at all. If there is no battleback set, the map will be blurred and used as the background. You can also prevent the blurring if you really want (someone else recently requested this around here, so you can probably find that easily).
